prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1179; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported in Sugar Land. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just leave my name out of it for now, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the vehicle that was hit.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was backing out of a parking space near the front entrance of the shopping center. The lot was pretty busy, with cars moving in every direction.

Q: What happened next?

A: I checked my mirrors, saw nothing behind me, and started reversing slowly. Then I felt a jolt on the driver's side. Another car had come down the aisle and clipped the rear quarter panel of mine.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not until right at the end. It was coming up the lane faster than I expected, and by the time I noticed it, there was no time to stop.

Q: Did you exit your vehicle after the collision?

A: Yes, I got out and walked around to look at the damage. Both cars had some scrapes and a dented bumper. The other driver came over and we exchanged information.

Q: How are you feeling physically since the collision?

A: My neck is really stiff, and I've got a constant ache in the upper back. Turning my head to look over my shoulder hurts quite a bit. I started physical therapy a few days ago, and I've been taking over-the-counter pain relievers.

Q: Have you sought any medical treatment?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. They diagnosed me with whiplash and told me to rest and follow up with my doctor.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I'm trying to get back to normal, and I'd appreciate a prompt response on the repair estimate.
